query_text: 有没有欢迎顾客带狗狗进店、还会给小狗准备水碗和零食的餐厅？
requirement_text: 评论需要说明这家餐厅是否欢迎宠物狗入内，以及是否有善待狗狗的具体表现。
evidence_span: Their outdoor seating is very dog friendly and before we even ordered the staff had brought a water bowl and treats for our pup.
evidence_context:
Stopped by for brunch today with the bf and our dog and we were seated immediately outside. Their outdoor seating is very dog friendly and before we even ordered the staff had brought a water bowl and treats for our pup. He was very pleased and so were we. 

The bf ordered the $15 lunch special with the salad and the ahi tuna poke bowl. There wasn't abbot left, he loved it. I had the French toast which was a little unusual but very tasty! (Just not your typical French toast w/ syrup). 

Our server was very nice and checked on both us and our pup! 

The prices were great considering the poke bowl is normally more than $15.

The patio was great and it's always a plus being able to have our dog join us for brunch. He got a lot of attention from staff and other diners. 

This was our first visit but I'm excited to come back and try dinner.

query_text: 想带我家狗一起出门吃饭，哪家餐馆是对狗狗很友好、会招待宠物的？
requirement_text: 评论需要说明该餐馆是否对狗友好以及是如何对待带来店里的宠物的。
evidence_span: They are dog friendly in the take out area and give the dogs bacon if you allow it.
evidence_context: I love the atmosphere of this place.  Even if you are just getting a quick coffee to go you are treated like a special guest.  I have tried several different sandwiches and salad and have thoroughly enjoyed each meal I ordered.  They are dog friendly in the take out area and give the dogs bacon if you allow it.

query_text: 请推荐一些可以让宠物狗跟着一起进店用餐的餐馆。
requirement_text: 评论需要说明餐馆是否允许狗狗进入、能否正常接待带宠物的顾客。
evidence_span: I have a service dog and they told me no dogs allowed.
evidence_context: The food was fair. I have a service dog and they told me no dogs allowed. When I reiterated that my dog was a service animal the server disappeared and came back and asked for papers. I said there are no "papers" and he left again. From there another server came out and waited on us. This server was not engaging and was slow to respond to our requests. There was only one other customer in the restaurant most of the time we were there. I was disappointed.

query_text: 带着家里的狗狗去找吃的，有哪家的用餐区是真正宠物友好的吗？
requirement_text: 评论需要说明餐厅是否真的允许宠物进入其用餐区域。
evidence_span: Not dog friendly! We called ahead and asked specifically if they allow dogs/pets on their outdoor patio
evidence_context: Not dog friendly! We called ahead and asked specifically if they allow dogs/pets on their outdoor patio and we're told "yes of course! Outdoor seating is first come." Walked their and the hostesses asked if our dog was a service animal, we said no and they said they don't allow pets and that they were "jut reminded right now of the policy."
